      "observations": [
        "Full6-file local address-book creation patch and every changed test hunk read. Fixed widget/input event, forward consumer, creation/open/reset sequence and direct test assertions inspected. Current flow opens created directory before awaited reset, differing from original request-close and unawaited reset. Three widget filename/class/tag pairs read only for local naming scope. Complete assigned Bug/review now reconciled; no runtime/browser/keyboard/AT/network check.",
        "Bug1967808 full comments0–4 were read for entry3017 and reused here. The edited description removes the requirement to open the address-book tab from this task. The original patch creates the local directory, requests hub closure and calls reset without awaiting it. Fixed accepted source resolves the directory, awaits opening its UID and then awaits reset; that later navigation is not credited to this original task or its child by association.",
        "D252216 was expanded twice through creation and all46 submitted inline bodies were read. Review asks for resetState on reopen, shared account integration helpers, concrete task names, ownerGlobal targeting and creation-topic/close-event waits. The landed patch adds local resetState, invokes view reset, names the creation tasks and moves integration coverage into browser_accountHubAb.js. The task remains above helper functions. Naming/grouping support is component-scoped and separate from formatter rules.",
        "The initial assignment-in-wait callback suggestion, author DRY reply and later easy-to-follow-test feedback are separate positions. Final view test takes optionSelect from awaited waitForCondition, but still assigns localForm in the visibility predicate. The historical integration test waits for optionSelect.hasConnected and local form width; disputed visibility/connection statements are not generalized into a custom-element guarantee.",
        "Changed assertions directly compare captured {name:test} and {name:empty}, directory-name existence, and the created directory dirName. The view task also resolves a promise in a footer forward listener; Assert.ok(true) only logs reaching that listener. The integration task registers addrbook-directory-created and close waits before clicking Forward, verifies the directory name, deletes it and awaits closure. All five added assertion calls have non-empty expected-behavior messages; absence of should in the event-log message is not a standalone review defect. No new test ran.",
        "The local-specific error-title request and author generic-passthrough objection are resolved in the actual changed blocks: the local creation case throws Local address book creation failed with cause; the outer forward handler shows error.title or error.message plus error.text/error object. These changed blocks add no console.error call. Rebase-markup questions and Done labels alone are not evidence that unrelated templates changed.",
        "The fixed integration comparison contains later Enter/tab/telemetry behavior. Its selected Glean Assert.deepEqual omits a message; this is a bounded comparison finding, not an assertion added by the original patch. PointerEvent is the separate3017 follow-up. Existing creation and local naming lessons remain linked rather than duplicated."
